description: This file defines a GTK-based Treeview widget for managing menu entries in MenuLibre, including functions for adding, removing, sorting, searching, and integrating with XDG menu standards.

classes.name: Treeview
classes.description: A GTK Box widget that provides a menu management interface with search, sorting, and XDG menu integration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Treeview widget, sets up GTK components, signals, and toolbar buttons.

methods.name: set_sortable
methods.description: Enables or disables the sort button.

methods.name: set_move_up_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the move up button.

methods.name: set_move_down_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the move down button.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry below the current selection.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry above the current selection.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Adds a new child entry to the selected item.

methods.name: remove_selected
methods.description: Removes the selected menu entry, optionally deleting associated files.

methods.name: remove_iter
methods.description: Removes a specific treeiter from the model.

methods.name: get_parent
methods.description: Returns the parent model and iterator of the current selection.

methods.name: is_first
methods.description: Checks if the current selection is the first item.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Calculates the next TreePath.

methods.name: is_last
methods.description: Checks if the current selection is the last item.

methods.name: get_parent_filename
methods.description: Returns filename of the parent item.

methods.name: get_parent_row_data
methods.description: Returns data of the parent row.

methods.name: get_selected_filename
methods.description: Returns filename of the selected item.

methods.name: get_selected_row_data
methods.description: Returns data of the selected row.

methods.name: set_can_select_function
methods.description: Sets an external function to determine if a row can be selected.

methods.name: update_launcher_instances
methods.description: Updates all instances of a launcher with new data.

methods.name: update_selected
methods.description: Updates the data of the selected row.

methods.name: _on_treeview_cursor_changed
methods.description: Handles cursor change events to update UI and emit signals.

methods.name: _on_treeview_key_press_event
methods.description: Handles key press events for navigation and expansion.

methods.name: _on_treeview_row_expansion
methods.description: Updates row data on expansion or collapse.

methods.name: _on_treeview_selection
methods.description: Handles selection changes with a custom can_select function.

methods.name: _set_treeview_selected_expanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses the selected row.

methods.name: _toggle_treeview_selected_expanded
methods.description: Toggles expansion state of selected row.

methods.name: _text_display_func
methods.description: Sets display style for text renderer based on row data.

methods.name: _icon_name_func
methods.description: Sets icon renderer based on row data.

methods.name: _get_selected_iter
methods.description: Returns the model and selected iterator.

methods.name: _populate_and_select_iter
methods.description: Fills a row with data and optionally selects it.

methods.name: _get_deletable_launcher
methods.description: Checks if a launcher file can be deleted.

methods.name: _get_delete_filenames
methods.description: Returns list of files to delete for a given row.

methods.name: _get_treeview_selected_expanded
methods.description: Checks if the selected row is expanded.

methods.name: _get_launcher_instances
methods.description: Finds all treeiters referencing a filename.

methods.name: _get_n_launcher_instances
methods.description: Returns count of launcher instances.

methods.name: _is_menu_locked
methods.description: Checks if menu editing is locked.

methods.name: _update_add_directory
methods.description: Determines if adding subdirectories is allowed.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Filters the treeview based on search terms.

methods.name: set_searchable
methods.description: Enables or disables search mode, optionally expanding all.

methods.name: _treeview_match
methods.description: Helper for filtering search results.

methods.name: _treeview_match_directory
methods.description: Checks if any child directory matches search.

methods.name: _treeview_match_func
methods.description: Filter function for search.

methods.name: xdg_menu_install
methods.description: Installs a desktop file into the menu structure.

methods.name: xdg_menu_uninstall
methods.description: Removes a desktop file from the menu structure.

methods.name: xdg_menu_update
methods.description: Triggers a menu update.

methods.name: update_menus
methods.description: Schedules menu XML update.

methods.name: update_menu_timeout
methods.description: Performs the actual menu XML update and KDE refresh.

methods.name: update_menus_kde
methods.description: Runs KDE menu cache update command.

methods.name: _cleanup_applications_merged
methods.description: Removes obsolete menu files from user config.

methods.name: _move_iter
methods.description: Moves a selected row up or down, possibly changing hierarchy.

methods.name: _get_iter_by_data
methods.description: Finds a row matching specific data.

methods.name: _move_iter_up_level
methods.description: Moves a row up one hierarchy level.

methods.name: _move_iter_down_level
methods.description: Moves a row down one hierarchy level.

methods.name: _sort_iter
methods.description: Sorts items alphabetically within a directory.

methods.name: scroll_to_selection
methods.description: Scrolls view to the selected item.

methods.name: set_search_entry
methods.description: Sets the search entry widget.

methods.name: reset_cursor
methods.description: Resets cursor to initial positions.
